topic.source_contract: water-body identity, ecological and chemical status, objectives, deterioration, mitigation and delivery evidence

scope_guards: An RBMP map is not treated as parcel-specific planning approval or refusal.
Good ecological status is not treated as proof that a proposal causes no deterioration.
Less-than-good status is not treated as an automatic development prohibition.
A programme-of-measures entry is not treated as funded or completed mitigation.
A screening opinion is not treated as a completed WFD compliance assessment.
Planning permission is not treated as an environmental permit or discharge consent.
Proposed mitigation is not treated as secured, built or monitored mitigation.
No score or promotion is written without exact water-body, impact, decision, mitigation, delivery and monitoring evidence.
